d: THE GLOAMING WATCH #3 — Nyrineia's Engine. Nylmiror spots it first: scorch marks in a perfect ring, at the edge of the Night Market. Starring Nyrineia (Ribex Nabris), Nylmiror (Docott Ricott), Olkae (Sefell Nemere). Lantern-keepers patrol the fog city after dark, solving the small strange mysteries the daylight misses.
